decisions.reason: The formwork profile system is a multi-model line close to the core offer and had its own page through 2019, so it likely meets aspirations and needs little search for alternative uses of resources.

Shuttering magnet blocks are a standard consumable in precast plants that complement the firm's integrated systems, so low-cost retention fits satisficing behaviour even though the product was only mentioned on the website.

The magnetic formwork component kept a dedicated page in both observed years, which signals adequate performance relative to aspiration, and the firm has slack to carry it as part of its formwork range.

This component is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with other magnetic formwork items, which makes it somewhat vulnerable to consolidation, but its low carrying cost and close fit with the core business favour keeping it.
